lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tm4Cu2Ag2 (reduced formula Tm2CuAg) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/mmm (No. 119), with eight atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Ag, Cu, and Tm centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.81 to 3.25 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and spans all eight sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal that Ag–Tm, Cu–Tm, and Tm–Tm 12-vertex coordination polyhedra each exhibit corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, while Ag–Ag and Cu–Cu pairs share corners and edges.
